args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A few notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Please treat "Pellow Home Living" as the current name, and "Covey & Lark" as the former name.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report title is out of date and likely needs renaming to match the new account name.
- Could you check whether any other saved reports, digests or CRM entries still use the old name?
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll (drafted by assistant)

args.text:
Bettina, the draft is saved in my mailbox, addressed to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It isn't sent yet, so someone needs to open it and send it.

It has Sofia's three bullets on the rename and the saved report title, plus your two lines: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I signed it "Bettina Kroll (drafted by assistant)", so tell me if you'd rather it not say that.
